name: SIQ-1-35B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA plus gated linear attention: 30 of 40 layers are linear_attention and 10 are full_attention, one every fourth layer
notes: ADDED 2026-11-17. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 34.661 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-06-14. WHY IT EARNED A RECORD: on its own card's co-measured GPQA-Diamond row (full 198 questions, all three models served as Q4_K_M GGUF, greedy, identical harness) it scores 70.2 against its base Qwen3.6-35B at 68.2 - a +2.0 point delta on the same test with the same quant, and it does it on 3,158 tokens/question vs the base's 3,500, so it is better AND cheaper per question. HONESTY CAVEATS recorded rather than smoothed: (1) the base column is a quant, not bf16 - the card prints no bf16 base number, so the comparison is quant-vs-quant; (2) the bf16 90.2 row is SIQ-only with no base column and is NOT the delta; (3) IFEval has no base value on the card, so no delta; (4) the ideation (30.2 vs base 10.2) and BullshitBench numbers come from the author's own autoresearch duel and a private judge panel - not co-measured public suites - and BullshitBench is a tie (1.047 vs Nex-N2-Pro 1.040), so nothing rests on them; (5) Terminal-Bench 2.1 is 'in progress' on the card, so no agentic claim is made. SIZE: params_b is 34.661 from the safetensors index, i.e. ONE BILLION fewer parameters than the base's 35.952 - an SFT/DPO/GRPO study would not remove weights, so this is most likely a re-export that drops the MTP layer rather than a genuine 1.3B-parameter prune; the card does not say. active_params_b 3.0 is inherited from the base record's figure, not re-derived from this repo. HARDWARE GATE passes: 8 of 256 experts routed per token over a 34.7B checkpoint, so the expert weights offload to system RAM cleanly; the card confirms it runs as a Q4_K_M GGUF. The card's own vLLM snippet and the IQ4_XS 18.9 GB GGUF are both cited on the card.
